Chart pe jo volume dikhta hai, wo asli nahi? 📊

Forex aur gold ke spot chart pe volume asal me tick volume hota hai: price kitni baar badla, ye ginti. Ek tick ke peeche 0.01 lot bhi ho sakta hai aur 100 lot bhi.
